verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any web-facing service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows a robots.txt at canada.ca. The only probe checked llms.txt, a different file, and found a soft 404, so it neither proves nor disproves a robots.txt and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
